action.instructions: Choose one action to win a rooftop ring-out duel. Preserve space behind you and stay inside the safe boundary. Read opponent wind-up and recovery, incoming projectiles, held props, distance and previous outcome. Use a different useful action when repeating the previous action failed. All choices execute with the same movement and attack timing as the human.

criteria.RETREAT_FROM_OPPONENT: Create throwing space or escape a close threat when there is safe space behind you.
criteria.PUSH_OPPONENT: Commit to a close shove when in range, especially during opponent recovery or with opponent near an edge.
criteria.GRAB_NEAREST_OBJECT: Go to and pick up the observed nearest object.
criteria.THROW_HELD_OBJECT_AT_OPPONENT: Throw the object currently held at opponent.
criteria.DODGE_LEFT: Evade a nearby opponent winding up a push or an incoming throw by moving sideways left.
criteria.DODGE_RIGHT: Evade a nearby opponent winding up a push or an incoming throw by moving sideways right.
criteria.MOVE_TOWARD_SAFETY: Regain central space when near an open edge or the shrinking sudden-death boundary.
criteria.TAKE_COVER: Use the ventilation unit to block a held or incoming projectile.

replay: 10 Hz sampled transforms; not deterministic physics resimulation
